title: Graphic Designer I
note: Entry-level role designing retail signage, in-store and large-format environmental graphics, with mentoring from senior designers.

facts.duties: Design retail signage, window and point-of-sale graphics, storefront and wayfinding graphics; prepare production-ready files; adapt artwork for multi-store rollouts; review proofs with vendors.
facts.requirements: 0–2 years of graphic design experience; degree in graphic design or related field; portfolio; Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign.
facts.apply: Apply on JLL's Workday careers site, requisition REQ548890.
